sentence: وِش لَونَك أَبْغَى أَبْعَت email لِلْمُدِير الحِين
raw: وش لونك أبغى أبعت email للمدير الحين
ipa: ˈwiʃ ˈloːnak ˈʔabɣaː ˈʔabʕat imeːl lilmuˈdiːr alˈħiːn
gloss_en: how are you, I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (8-vowel set, mid /eː/ present). Qassimi/Najdi frame وش لونك/عساك/أبغى/زين/مو/هذا/الحين/مرّة (ingham1994; alhoody2019 p.42); وِش لَونَك greeting, لَون→[loːn] monophthong. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: عِنْدِي laptop جَدِيد بَس wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕindiː labtub dʒaˈdiːd ˈbas wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], alhoody2019 §5.1.1); wifi→wifi. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl. Najdi possessive حَقّ (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ مَعَ manager بُكْرَة
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع manager بكرة
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈmaʕa manadʒar ˈbukra
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager tomorrow
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/ kept, ج=/dʒ/ ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: we have to do an update for the program now
notes: [tech] update→abdat (/p/→[b]). Najdi نْسَوِّي 'we do', الحِين 'now' (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: أَنَا think هَذَا model غَالِي مَرَّة
raw: أنا think هذا model غالي مرة
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaðaː mudil ˈɣaːliː ˈmarra
gloss_en: I think this model is very expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (interdental /θ/ retained, alhoody2019 p.41); model→mudil. Intensifier مَرَّة 'very' (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: فِيه offer زَين وْ discount كْبِير
raw: فيه offer زين و discount كبير
ipa: ˈfiːh ufar ˈzeːn w disawnt ˈkbiːr
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt. Najdi زَين 'good' (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I paid cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ (/k/ before /a/, no affrication). Negator مُو /muː/ (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: service مُو زَين وْ delivery مِتْأَخِّر
raw: service مو زين و delivery متأخر
ipa: sarfis ˈmuː ˈzeːn w dilifari mitˈʔaxxir
gloss_en: the service is not good and the delivery is late
notes: [commerce] service→sarfis (/v/→[f], alhoody2019 §5.1.2); delivery→dilifari. مُو + زَين (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I took the car to a garage now
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (final loan /dʒ/ kept). وَدَّيت→[waddeːt] /aj/→[eː] (alhoody2019 p.42). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: this model is new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik. Demonstrative هَذَا; جَدِيد ج=/dʒ/. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: نْشُوفَك فِي weekend إِن شَاء الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak ˈfiː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔ ˈallah
gloss_en: we'll see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. Najdi نْشُوفَك (ingham1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I want a kilo of dates from the market
notes: [commerce] loan كيلو 'kilo'; attested [ˈkiːlu] — the European loan RESISTS the Qassimi /k/→[ts] affrication (Alhoody 2019 appendix, item kilo /ˈkiːləʊ/→[ˈkiːlu]). PIPELINE WRONG: reads the Arabic-script loan as native and fires the affrication rule → [ˈtsiːluː]. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I went to the market and bought bread
notes: [commerce] loan ماركت 'market'; attested [ˈmaːrkit] — /k/ before front /ɪ/ stays [k], RESISTS affrication (Alhoody 2019, market /ˈmɑːkɪt/→[ˈmaːrkit]). PIPELINE WRONG: emits [aˈlmaːrtsit] (native affrication /k/→[ts]). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I wore a new jacket
notes: [daily] loan جاكيت 'jacket'; attested [dʒaˈkeːt] — /k/ before front vowel stays [k], /ɪ/→[eː] (Alhoody 2019 §6.1.3, jacket /ˈdʒæk.ɪt/→[dʒaˈkeːt]). PIPELINE WRONG: emits [dʒaˈːtsiːt] (affricates /k/→[ts] and misplaces stress). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: the car went for a service this morning
notes: [automotive] loan سرفيس 'service' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f], alhoody2019 §5.1.2); no front-vowel velar, pipeline matches attested [sarfiːs]. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: I took the amount in cash
notes: [commerce] loan كاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ] (Alhoody 2019, cash /kæʃ/→[kaːʃ], /æ/→[aː]). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

gloss_en: how are you, hope you're well
notes: [daily] Arabizi (3arabi): 3=ع. Spells وش لونك عساك طيب. Pipeline has no Arabizi path (translit never sniffs Latin as Arabic); ipa is the Qassimi reading, لَون→[loːn] monophthong (alhoody2019 p.42; ingham1994).

sentence: abgha aroo7 al soog wana ta3baan
raw: abgha aroo7 al soog wana ta3baan
gloss_en: I want to go to the market and I'm tired
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع. Spells أبغى أروح السوق وأنا تعبان. unsupported; ipa = Qassimi reading, qaf→[ɡ] in sūg (ingham1994; alhoody2019 p.41).

gloss_en: come by the house after dinner
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 3=ع. Spells تعال عند البيت بعد العشا. unsupported; ipa = Qassimi reading, /aj/→[eː] monophthong in bēt (alhoody2019 p.42).
